describes: Current thread, link and script/resource/appearance boundaries.

cases.name: threads-and-members
cases.covers: Threads sort by page, page-space y and creation date; every reply/group/status member resolves its root.

cases.name: threads-nan-top
cases.covers: An explicitly malformed NaN page-space y compares as a tie without panicking; engine protocol input is tagged.

cases.name: threads-off-the-layout
cases.covers: Off-layout pages sort last, including after a current remote creation and mirror refresh.

cases.name: reply-edit-status-marked
cases.covers: Replies target the root; text updates and derived measurement rejection are current; review states chain to the current reviewer and marked states target the root.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: a measurement's text is worked out from its points

$error.name: Error
$error.message: [annotation] no comment thread contains this ref

cases.name: status-without-a-previous-one
cases.covers: Without caller identity, review status replies to the root.

cases.name: remove-and-remove-thread-atomically
cases.covers: Delete preflight blocks the whole thread; permitted root deletion is atomic, and an engine refusal preserves every member.

$error.name: Error
$error.message: [annotation] no comment thread contains this ref

cases.name: comment-permissions
cases.covers: Named current can* members expose create, text and whole-thread delete authority, including locked contents, dimension and unknown refs.

cases.name: attached-links
cases.covers: Current links set/create, retarget, preserve read-only targets and clear the attached group child; a link annotation and missing parents are read without mutation.

cases.name: links-follow-geometry-and-props
cases.covers: A parent move writes its link child in the same Change; selected markup creates one child per quad, and an intended child refusal rolls back the whole link change.

cases.name: rapid-link-sets-use-pending-identity
cases.covers: Two sets use the same stable-born pending child; both writes name the same child before ordered confirmations.

cases.name: link-updates-queue-across-parents
cases.covers: Rapid link changes preserve each parent target and stable child identity while every pending write retains its stated target and ordered confirmations settle them.

cases.name: script-commits
cases.covers: The script sink lowers current loaded fields and colors; an unloaded resolved ref fails staging before apply, while a separate batch exercises unresolved/transparent inputs and stops on an explicit engine refusal.

results.error: transparent stroke colours are not supported

cases.name: script-commits-through-actions
cases.covers: The real actions plugin and annotation plugin connect their current script sink and release it on close.

cases.name: attachment-download
cases.covers: The current resource door reads file bytes by role and rejects an unknown ref.

cases.name: baked-appearances-through-render
cases.covers: Engine appearances belong to the render plugin; the annotation projection preserves current image/version data and returns an empty list after a render refusal.

throws.name: Error
throws.message: projection does not request a URL

cases.name: appearance-scale-owned-by-render
cases.covers: The current render capability snaps appearance scale to the advertised engine lattice.
